status: contract; admission is recorded by signed receipts
scope: Reuse complete locally received source copies during package reception and association.
requirements: Receiver standing must authenticate exactly one current expected pin per source and world.
Current pin and world bytes must hash to those pins through safe admitted paths.
Connected document and overlay bytes and file sets must equal the received verified inputs.
Every ordered source dependency must independently pass the same validation.
Any failed validation prevents reuse; ordinary connect and consent rules continue to apply.
A package, progress marker or recorded success grants no receiver authority.
verification: The native reader executes the same two-domain assertions as the test runner against current modules.
limits: No cross-call consent or crash recovery claim
No private API data in vectors
No change to Bound or authority coverage
